reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent; actually viewed the full exact source, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet and naiwa reference, inspected native-resolution raw detail regions, and verified the recorded evidence, source PNG, output, task, prompt, request, result and sheet SHA-256 values plus image metadata with read-only Python.

remaining_reasons: The source has a viewer-right three-quarter head pose and rightward gaze, but external-03 visibly turns the mascot toward viewer left, with the small far eye and mouth mass on viewer left and the large near eye on viewer right. Restore the source viewer-right orientation and rightward gaze while retaining the existing source-bound cap, clothing, note and tab positions.
entries.positive_observation: The compact yellow mascot has green-ringed solid black eyes, one closed mouth, no human skin, nose or ears, dark brows and a clean-shaven chin; the source-covered hair and absence of glasses are retained. The dark olive peaked cap keeps its small upper eagle, larger lower wreath/cockade, gold braid/piping and glossy black visor. The dark olive tunic and gold-embroidered red standing-collar tabs remain, with natural short broad collar contact and no long neck, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. The opaque dark backplate and complete frame remain. The note has two compact upper mark rows, largely blank lower paper and a small dark right-edge tab.
entries.alpha_decision: The native RGBA exterior itself passes visible-alpha-v1: the full white/cyan/alpha comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost photographic backing, clothing transparency or working-matte halo. Actual returned extrema [0, 254] are retained and internal 252-254 values were not treated as defects. This alpha acceptance does not override the visible pose/gaze rejection; no source-alpha replacement was performed or is required for this art defect.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap and collar embroidery motifs and the note glyphs are unreadable at source scale; no rejection is based on those details. The reversed head orientation and gaze are directly visible in the exact source and full/native raw comparison.
